sn35.117:1.4: _Attarūpa_ (“in my own way”) is also at [an4.117:1.1]() and [dn27:3.3](). Commentary glosses, “in conformity with one’s own nature”, with the secondary sense, “for one’s own benefit”. | See note on _attakāmarūpa_ at [mn31:3.5]().
sn35.117:1.7: See notes in Bodhi, *Connected Discourses*, for readings and grammar.
